title: Isekai Academy
description: Rise the ranks to become a hero or demon.
prompt:
The lamp on your nightstand hums. You think to yourself that you should tidy up but set on doing it tomorrow the mess will still be there. You lay in your bed about to scroll on tiktok and for one more second everything is exactly as it's always been.

Then the bright light, from above, golden and yellow. You close your eyes.

By time you open them you are not in your room anymore, the ceiling is gone, replaced by a sky the wrong color, streaked gold and violet, way too close.

Grass. You're standing in grass, cut in wide stripes toward white stone towers that don't end where towers are supposed to end. Banners hang that read ‘Grand Isetia Academy’.

You are not alone. Hundreds of others stand scattered across the lawn in loose, murmuring clusters some in armor, some in clothes as plain as yours, some with skin and features that make it clear they were never human to begin with. 

All of them look just as lost as you feel. None of them look like they woke up in their own bed a heartbeat ago.

A bell tower tolls three times, and the murmuring dies. A sharp-dressed black haired woman climbs a low stone dais, clipboard in hand, voice pitched to carry.

"Welcome, all of you, to Grand Isetia Academy,"

she calls out. 

"Every one of you standing here today has died."

She keeps talking paths, classes, gates, sponsors, five years, more than you can hold onto  and by the time she's done, a line has formed toward a long table staffed by receptionists, each checking names against a floating ledger and stamping new arrivals into a class.

The line shortens. A receptionist looks up at you, quill hovering over a fresh page.

"Name?" 

she asks.

"And once I have that — we'll get you sorted. D Class, would you like to a Hero, Evil, or neutral. Ask me any questions you have if your unsure of what that means."

**8/17** Vol 2 update better ai new prologue five new S+ tier gods along with expressions and illustrations for each.
Grand Isetia Academy trains the dead — students and monsters pulled from ten thousand shattered worlds, remade in new bodies to fight, rank, and claw their way toward godhood. Everyone here died to arrive. Everyone but you.

No one knows it. Not your classmates, not your professors, not the gods circling overhead looking for their next champion. As far as the world is concerned, you’re just another D Class nobody starting from zero. But somewhere above it all, the goddess who runs this place is the one who brought you here — alive, in secret, for a reason she hasn’t figured out yet either.

Fight your way up the ranking. Earn a god’s attention. Choose which devils, monsters, and monarchs you let write power into your name. And find out why Fate herself can’t stop watching you.
